Over $200K in Luxury Upgrades  Its Like Buying a Brand-New Home! This newly remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence in San Franciscos desirable Outer Sunset feels like moving into a brand-new home. Just minutes from the ocean and Golden Gate Park, the property blends high-end design with coastal charm.

Inside, an open-concept floor plana rarity in Sunset homesis flooded with natural light from three skylights. The chefs kitchen is the heart of the home, showcasing a Calcutta quartz backsplash, a waterfall breakfast island, custom luxury cabinetry, and chef-grade appliances. The living space is anchored by a sleek modern electric fireplace, while recessed lighting throughout adds warmth and sophistication.

The upstairs bathroom has been completely transformed with spa-inspired finishes, including custom tilework, gold fixtures, and curated details. Additional upgrades include a brand-new HVAC system, updated electrical, and a reimagined backyard with new concrete and retaining walls to maximize outdoor space.

Completing the home is a large garage offering parking, storage, and expansion potentialan added bonus for city living.

Outdoors, a newly landscaped backyard provides a private retreat designed for relaxation and low maintenance. Best value in the Sunset!
